task: Redo Scott Paul's Phi Health / Frequency Blueprint agents because the visible 3 production-ready agents were weak starter prompts, not usable agents.
failure_point: The Blueprint rendered short visible prompt starters while claiming production-ready AI agents. The generator only checked that prompt text existed, and the pipeline fallback generated short generic prompts when profile prompt_1/prompt_2/prompt_3 were missing.
root_cause: scripts/gen-blueprint.py accepted non-empty prompt strings without requiring operating-runbook structure.
scripts/blueprint-pipeline-orchestrator.py Stage 5 fallback prompts were useful outlines but not complete agent runbooks.
scripts/blueprint_gatekeeper_100.py had no dedicated agent-prompt quality gate, so weak prompt cards could pass non-production checks.
action_log: Expanded Scott's six profile agents into operational runbooks with identity, inputs, workflow, output schema, rules, escalation/human-review boundary, and first-run test.
Updated the three visible copy-paste prompt cards to use the full Guest Research, Episode Knowledge Graph, and Claims/Citation Review runbooks.
Added validate_production_agent_prompt() to scripts/gen-blueprint.py so weak profile prompt content hard-fails at render time.
Strengthened scripts/blueprint-pipeline-orchestrator.py Stage 5 fallback prompts into full production-style runbooks.
Added scripts/blueprint_agent_prompt_quality_gate.py and wired it into scripts/blueprint_gatekeeper_100.py.
Added a regression test in tests/test_blueprint_regressions.py to pin the generator and gatekeeper wiring.

known_remaining_non_agent_blocker.format_conformance: 7/8 because the existing NotebookLM short podcast is 5:00; gate expects 8-12 minutes.
known_remaining_non_agent_blocker.run_audit: 15/16 because D3-03_podcast_duration_8to12min_RL fails on the same 5:00 podcast.

hypothesis: A future weak-agent regression will now fail either at blueprint generation, at the dedicated gatekeeper check, or in the regression suite.
next_move: Publish scoped changes to GitHub Pages and verify public HTML contains the production runbook markers.
